comparison.objective: Install an O-ring into a plug groove; candidate extracts a crimp terminal from a housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled elastic stretching and untwisted seating versus rigid guided insertion, tang release, and push-then-pull extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the ring seated square without overstretch; candidate requires the chosen terminal removed while the reusable housing and neighbors remain intact. Candidate force limits are unmeasured.
comparison.reason: Elastic seal installation tests materially different physics and dexterity from connector depinning.
